input: own inventory/tank, optional owner UUID/name, droneItems variable-size handler, energy, variables, chunk flags
output: restores owner/defaultfallback; temp handler defines usable drone slots; copies items then refreshes side configurator; retains variable compound
preservation: Controller owns two distinct inventories; destination drone slot capacity established before payload transfer.
application_limit: UUID.fromString on malformed present ID throws; copy helper deep-copy behavior not resolved. Borrow size/owner initialization before restoring owned data, not arbitrary fallback identity for Dynasty player.

input: Items inventory, programOnInsert flag, history list and programmable widget compounds
output: restores inventory, displayedStack derives from slot0; appends history and adds empty list if no history; loads program widgets
preservation: Persisted editor history not regenerated from current displayed item alone; no active program executed by this method.
application_limit: history.addAll without clear may duplicate on repeated load. Borrow idempotent history/progress transfer; distinguish real receipts from current display cache.

input: Items including PROGRAM_SLOT plus saved program fields, home flag/text
output: restores items first; only nonempty program item resolves curProgram; nonnull program then reads its saved continuation from root
preservation: Actual saved program identity chooses continuation decoder; prevents blindly loading one program data into an unknown/null program.
application_limit: Does not explicitly clear stale curProgram when slot empty. Borrow source mechanism identity before interpreting old progress schema.

input: Items compound, clawProgress, clawClosing and state byte
output: restores carried inventory and associated physical operation state
preservation: Actual item owner restores both cargo and animation continuation; shows persistent on disk can include temporary motion state.
application_limit: No state-byte range guard; no assertion claw state should persist across player death. Borrow permanent-versus-temporary classification by consumer semantics, not serialization alone.

input: Items, input/output progress, interfaceMode ordinal, exportAny
output: restores buffer/progress and direction mode via enum ordinal
preservation: Cargo restored into owned inventory rather than granted to player; operation mode controls interpretation of buffer.
application_limit: Unchecked InterfaceDirection.values index can throw. Borrow checked schema/types when restoring old progression, not unchecked numeric enum assumption.

input: multiblock geometry, variable-size itemsInChamber/craftedItems handlers, Valves int arrays
output: sets multiblock; copies inputs and outputs only up to each fixed max; clears/rebuilds valve position list only for arrays length3
preservation: Input and crafted output use independent capacity bounds; avoids slot exceptions while preserving supported-range payload.
application_limit: Excess source slots silently omitted, not guaranteed lossless upgrade. Borrow validate capacity and report leftovers, never discard legacy player fields silently.

input: Items, target/GPS angles, force, tracked UUIDMost/Least records and optional previous inventory coordinates/side
output: restores cargo, rebuilds tracking set, reconstructs UUIDs from long pair; missing inventoryX clears both previous-position and side
preservation: Optional compound state clears paired fields together, preventing stale coordinate-side mismatch; tracking references kept with cargo.
application_limit: Most/Least longs default0 if absent; no malformed entry checks. Borrow validate complete reference pair rather than broad prefix copy.

input: super inventory payload plus LastSlot and Filter compound list with Slot index
output: base handler restores actual contents; reader restores cursor and parses filter stack at explicit slot
preservation: Saved items and filter policy are different roles; both must be considered when restoring container behavior.
application_limit: filter[index] has no bounds check and array not cleared here; bad index throws and repeated import may keep stale filters. Borrow validated slot/key allowlist rather than copying arbitrary fields.

input: itemStack, optional recipe ID, consumed item list, crafting ticks/status and autoYoink
output: restores output/input stack, recipe and consumed resources; crafting continuation restored; absent autoYoink defaults true
preservation: Restores consumed accounting alongside continuation rather than starting new craft/recharging resources. Local newly allocated itemsTag is unused, not credited as actual data transfer.
application_limit: Recipe tryParse can yield null; consumed list helper failure behavior not studied. Borrow keep progress and spent-resource/claimed-reward receipts paired without executing reward.

input: settings codec, invs position list, optional mainLecternPos and bookwyrm UUID array list
output: clears/rebuilds inventory links with null runtime handlers, resets main link, rebuilds bookwyrm UUID set and marks updateItems
preservation: Stores reference positions then rebuilds runtime item handlers later; copying live handler references would be wrong.
application_limit: Invalid UUID array can throw; positions may point to absent blocks. Borrow detach runtime references from durable owner data and validate optional identity fields.

input: currentCraft stack, CraftingManager tag, entity/mana/potion flags, craftingIndex, boundedInvs and cooldown
output: restores actual crafting stack and manager, reinitializes bounded storage position list, retains progress index and cooldown
preservation: Incomplete craft state spans payload+manager+resource availability, not one integer; list rebuilt instead of appended.
application_limit: Nested manager decoder not independently credited. Cooldown serialization is not grounds for death retention; Dynasty needs semantic permanent whitelist.

input: optional lectern position, held item compound, backoff and optional color
output: restores held cargo and home link, backoff; color only when present
preservation: Cargo is actual saved stack independent of color customization. Real item-bearing entity reader qualifies; cosmetic color field does not receive separate credit.
application_limit: Absent lectern does not clear old field; parseOptional can yield empty. Borrow missing-field policy per role rather than treat all fields as required.

input: item compound, age, offset flags/amount and from/to vectors
output: loads carried ItemStack into entityData, then restores flight continuation
preservation: Real item transfer entity owns cargo persisted with travel endpoints; restoring only trajectory would lose payload.
application_limit: No validation visible for age/vector schema and entityData updates may sync later. Borrow preserve real payload and only audited metadata, no blanket client state copying.

input: optional starbuncleData charm schema, held item, backoff and tamed flag
output: decodes mutable charm data/default compound; creates behavior; restores held cargo/tamed; initializes goals once and restores behavior tag; sync only server
preservation: Durable behavior definition is rebuilt into runtime strategy; guarded one-time goal reset avoids stacking duplicate goals.
application_limit: Registry behavior may be null; nested charm codec defaults not all traced. Borrow explicit new-owner initialization and schema-bound field restore rather than copying old manager references.

input: base/slot sizes, stack/cosmetic children, render/active lists, role flags/drop rule, PermanentModifiers versus Modifiers
output: resizes first; restores stacks; restores toggles with current-value defaults; permanent modifiers through addPermanentModifier, other list through addTransientModifier
preservation: Same persistent record explicitly distinguishes permanent and transient modifier lifetimes. Both are serialized, so serialization alone cannot define death permanence.
application_limit: Render/active loops unbounded to target size may throw; modifiers added without visible clear here. Borrow whitelist correct lifetime fields and avoid duplicating existing Dynasty slot/PlayerPersisted clone ownership.
